query: Consider LiiON's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document allow verbally conveyed information to be considered as Confidential Information?
gold: (b) “Confidential Information” means: (1) any information, whether tangi-ble or intangible, in written or in machine readable form that is marked or designated in writing as “Proprietary” or “Confidential” at the time of disclosure; (2) any information disclosed orally or visually to Receiving Party, provided that such information is orally identified as “Confidential” or “Proprietary” prior to or at the time of its disclosure,
rag_answer: Yes. Under the LiiON Non-Disclosure Agreement, orally conveyed information can be considered “Confidential Information” if it is orally identified as “Confidential” or “Proprietary” prior to or at the time of disclosure.

judge.gold_summary: 金标规定 Confidential Information 包括口头或视觉披露的信息，前提是该信息在披露前或披露时被口头标识为 Confidential 或 Proprietary。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答称口头传达的信息可构成 Confidential Information，前提是在披露前或披露时被口头标识为 Confidential 或 Proprietary。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标中关于口头信息构成保密信息的关键条件，与问题直接相关且无矛盾。
